facts.fact: The National Statistics Office, National Registration Bureau and Ministry of Health published Malawi's first vital statistics report from civil registration records (births 2015-2022, deaths 2017-2022, with causes of death), launched in April 2025; the date is the month of publication, not the years the figures cover.

systems.tiers: health facility; district registration office; headquarters

note: The preface commits NSO, NRB and MoH to produce the report annually, but this is the first edition so no series is recorded.
